epics.title: Deterministic coordination that keeps admitted work progressing
epics.description:
Source audit: engine::action_as records pause/resume as human with no trusted actor provenance; API bootstrap exposes a shared local mutation token and guard does not distinguish worker from operator, so adding a client-provided actor label alone is insufficient. engine::reconcile returns for workspace pause/auto_advance=false, and task-paused states have no release owner or deadline. Runner::start_scheduler updates heartbeat/health after each tick, while api::snapshot calls coordinator mode running solely when workspace is unpaused. dispatch_status collapses diverse pending states into blocked. Plan import validates task graph correctness but not executable stage coverage or a durable run intention. Presence reports do not register automatic receivers. eligible_for conflates unavailable routes/capacity/review/workspace/budget prerequisites as string reasons. Store::mutate wraps the full reconcile/dispatch/claim tick in one transaction; a task-specific reconciliation error can roll back unrelated progress (risk to reproduce, not an observed incident). Current supervisor recovery is capped at one repair; recurrence and repair exhaustion deliberately return to blocked with no future executor, and tests/blocker_recovery.rs explicitly asserts no claim after recurrence. This is an owned label, not a durable liveness guarantee. The chess incident showed permissions/network limitations mistaken for terminal workflow blockage; paused animation tasks demonstrated agent-created holds that survive forever. The user reports a third stop; its distinct cause is unverified and must be reconstructed from retained events/backups rather than invented.

Deliver server-enforced pause authority, durable run intent, typed blocking reasons, continuous supervised recovery and progress watchdogs. A green heartbeat, a task labeled coordinator-owned, or a prompt instructing an agent to continue is not proof of progress. Safety invariants remain mandatory.

tasks.title: Enforce trusted pause authority and expiring operational holds
tasks.description: Replace ambiguous pause booleans with durable intent/provenance and typed holds where needed. Separate user stop from machine scheduling reservations. Worker-origin calls cannot manufacture user-authorized indefinite holds. Design a trusted authority mechanism appropriate to the local same-account trust boundary; document what cannot be isolated from a fully privileged local process. Migrate legacy ambiguous pauses explicitly, without blanket auto-resume.
acceptance: Worker credentials cannot invoke operator-only pause or impersonate operator through request fields.
Machine holds carry owner, reason, release condition/deadline and deterministic expiry/reconciliation across restart.
Explicit user stop stays stopped; worker crashes or abandoned reservations do not strand admitted work.

tasks.title: Replace exhausted repair dead ends with supervised recovery state machine
tasks.description: Replace one-repair-then-blocked behavior with explicit machine-owned incident lifecycle, finite strategies, capability-aware worker selection, bounded backoff and persistent retry triggers. Reuse incident identity and preserve failed evidence. Avoid unbounded tight retries, recursive task creation, budget resets, false completion and unsafe permission expansion. When capability is genuinely unavailable, retain an executable supervisor loop that rechecks concrete capability/configuration changes instead of returning a user action item. Define outcome for finite strategy exhaustion honestly.
acceptance: Original blocked, worker needs_input, failed attempts, recurring failure after reviewed repair and repair failure all retain next machine action or a concrete monitored prerequisite.
Independent repair review precedes original retry; recurrence does not terminate the supervisor loop silently.
Budgets and approval/fence constraints remain enforced; tests demonstrate bounded resource use during persistent failure and automatic recovery when its prerequisite returns.
